sourceContext.originPage: FNBO Personal Savings page (coverage-gap section for personal-banking-product template)

contentPattern.structure: per card: icon + product title + primary CTA + description + benefit bullet list + secondary Learn More link

suitableFor: product-comparison card rows (savings/checking/loan products side by side)
solution cards with icon + title + CTA + description + feature list
3-up bordered product tiles with dual CTAs
notSuitableFor: compact icon + label navigation tiles (use cards-category)
icon + title + description-only feature rows (use cards-feature)
colored promo cards with a single CTA and large imagery (use cards-promo)
